recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is recommended unless the work group later chooses to define an active ImplementationGuide compatibility section; the broken-link correction requested by FHIR-44130 is already present.
issue_request: FHIR-44130 is an Applied/Persuasive technical correction for FHIR-core ImplementationGuide. It reported that the Scope and Usage sentence linked "below" to implementationguide.html#compatibility, but that fragment had no active target on the page.
initial_application: The issue was applied on git master by commit 5a320a0ca0, which changed source/implementationguide/implementationguide-introduction.xml to remove the parenthetical "see below" link and leave the compatibility requirement as plain text. No prior Issue-Reconcile-Key commit for FHIR-44130 was present on the combined branch before this audit.
additional_context: ImplementationGuide is an active resource in source/fhir.ini, so source/implementationguide/implementationguide-introduction.xml feeds the current build. The only remaining compatibility anchor in source/implementationguide/implementationguide-notes.xml is inside an XML comment for a long-commented-out compatibility list, so it is not an active section that the Scope and Usage text should target. Zulip and Confluence searches found no directly relevant or conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current source already removes the broken #compatibility link while preserving the intended compatibility statement.
